{-# LANGUAGE ForeignFunctionInterface #-}
module Auth.Session (
  SessionPool,
  newSessionPool,
  authenticateUser,
  gracefulShutdown
) where

import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.ForeignPtr
import Foreign.C.Types
import Foreign.C.String
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- FFI bindings to native crypto context
foreign import ccall "create_auth_ctx" c_create_auth_ctx :: CInt -> IO (Ptr ())
foreign import ccall "&destroy_auth_ctx" c_destroy_auth_ctx :: FunPtr (Ptr () -> IO ())
foreign import ccall "verify_credential" c_verify_credential :: Ptr () -> CString -> CString -> IO CInt

data SessionState = Active | Draining | Terminated
  deriving (Eq, Show)

data SessionEntry = SessionEntry
  { seContext   :: ForeignPtr ()
  , seCreatedAt :: Int
  , seLastUsed  :: IORef Int
  }

data SessionPool = SessionPool
  { spSessions  :: MVar (Map.Map String SessionEntry)
  , spState     :: MVar SessionState
  , spMaxIdle   :: Int
  , spDrainRef  :: IORef Bool
  }

newSessionPool :: Int -> IO SessionPool
newSessionPool maxIdle = do
  sessions <- newMVar Map.empty
  state <- newMVar Active
  drainRef <- newIORef False
  let pool = SessionPool sessions state maxIdle drainRef
  _ <- forkIO (reaper pool)
  return pool

reaper :: SessionPool -> IO ()
reaper pool = do
  threadDelay (30 * 1000000)
  st <- readMVar (spState pool)
  case st of
    Terminated -> return ()
    _ -> do
      now <- getCurrentTimestamp
      modifyMVar_ (spSessions pool) $ \m -> do
        let (expired, alive) = Map.partition (\e -> now - seCreatedAt e > spMaxIdle pool) m
        -- Let GC handle finalization via ForeignPtr; no explicit finalize
        return alive
      reaper pool

getCurrentTimestamp :: IO Int
getCurrentTimestamp = return 0  -- simplified

createSession :: String -> IO SessionEntry
createSession userId = do
  ptr <- c_create_auth_ctx 256
  fptr <- newForeignPtr c_destroy_auth_ctx ptr
  now <- getCurrentTimestamp
  lastRef <- newIORef now
  return $ SessionEntry fptr now lastRef

authenticateUser :: SessionPool -> String -> String -> IO (Either String Bool)
authenticateUser pool userId password = do
  st <- readMVar (spState pool)
  case st of
    Active -> doAuth pool userId password
    Draining -> do
      isDraining <- readIORef (spDrainRef pool)
      if isDraining
        then return (Left "Server is shutting down")
        else doAuth pool userId password
    Terminated -> return (Left "Pool terminated")

doAuth :: SessionPool -> String -> String -> IO (Either String Bool)
doAuth pool userId password = do
  sessions <- readMVar (spSessions pool)
  entry <- case Map.lookup userId sessions of
    Just existing -> do
      now <- getCurrentTimestamp
      writeIORef (seLastUsed existing) now
      return existing
    Nothing -> do
      newEntry <- createSession userId
      modifyMVar_ (spSessions pool) $ \m ->
        return (Map.insert userId newEntry m)
      return newEntry
  withForeignPtr (seContext entry) $ \ctxPtr -> do
    cUser <- newCString userId
    cPass <- newCString password
    result <- c_verify_credential ctxPtr cUser cPass
    free cUser
    free cPass
    return $ Right (result == 1)

-- Graceful shutdown: remove references and let GC finalize
gracefulShutdown :: SessionPool -> IO ()
gracefulShutdown pool = do
  modifyMVar_ (spState pool) $ \_ -> return Draining
  writeIORef (spDrainRef pool) True
  threadDelay (5 * 1000000)  -- 5s drain period
  -- Clear the map; ForeignPtr finalizers run only via GC
  modifyMVar_ (spSessions pool) $ \_ -> return Map.empty
  modifyMVar_ (spState pool) $ \_ -> return Terminated
